abstract: Between 1970 and 1991, 22 patients with pure immature teratoma were treated at the Center of Oncology in Krakow. Sixteen (72.7%) patients had stage I, four (18.2%) stage II, and two (9.1%) stage III of disease, nine (40.9%) patients had grade 1, 11 (50%) grade 2, and two (9.1%) grade 3 tumors. Eight stage Ia, grade 1 patients were treated with surgery only, the remaining 14 (63.6%) received postoperative chemotherapy. Five-year NED (no evidence of disease) survival was achieved in 81.8% of patients. Out of 16 stage I patients, 15 (93.8%) survived 5-year NED, out of six stage II and III, three (50%) patients only survived this period. We cured all grade 1 patients, and 81.8% (9/11) grade 2; two grade 3 patients died because of tumors. We also cured all six stage Ia patients, treated with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy (with or without chemotherapy), and all eight stage Ia grade 1 patients treated with surgery only.
abstract_ja: 1970年から1991年の間に、クラクフ腫瘍センターで純粋未熟奇形腫の患者22例が治療された。16例(72.7%)が病期I、4例(18.2%)が病期II、2例(9.1%)が病期IIIであった。グレード1が9例(40.9%)、グレード2が11例(50%)、グレード3が2例(9.1%)であった。病期Ia・グレード1の8例は手術のみで治療し、残りの14例(63.6%)は術後化学療法を受けた。5年無病生存率は81.8%の患者で得られた。病期Iの16例中15例(93.8%)が5年無病生存を達成し、病期II・IIIの6例中3例(50%)のみが同期間生存した。グレード1の患者は全例治癒し、グレード2は81.8%(9/11)が治癒した。グレード3の2例は腫瘍により死亡した。病期Iaの6例は、片側卵管卵巣摘除術(化学療法の有無を問わず)で治療し、全例治癒した。病期Ia・グレード1の8例は手術のみで治療し、全例治癒した。
